provider: Billing-owned collection business identities, balanced postings, immutable customer-safe cash receipts, audit and settlement evidence against real persisted W03 obligations
Minimal Wallet-owned approved cash-custody records, purpose-specific holds and projections linked to authoritative Billing postings without a second ledger
Current Identity and C assignment/work authority, independent treasury approval and A account/guest receipt access through accepted public contracts
integration: Billing collection provider followed by Wallet custody provider against accepted merged dependencies, then A/C/D consumers
E-serialized actual customer/operator/admin completion-to-collection-to-downloadable-receipt-to-custody-to-settlement journey and failure recovery on the immutable combined candidate
excluded: Live money collection, production treasury exercises, external payment verification, live provider refunds and deployment
Customer stored-value funding or withdrawal, a fourth checkout method, payroll, marketplace balances or unapproved custody holders/purposes
Cross-owner source/database access, private peer DTOs, E-owned manifests/contracts/clients/Gateway/broker/CI/infra edits and W05 business execution

evidenceScope: Declarative acceptance specification only. No cash collection, business receipt, journal, Wallet custody/hold, settlement, PostgreSQL constraint, HTTP authority, broker recovery, downloadable artifact or three-app acceptance is executed or established by this file.

entryBlockers.meaning: E-published verified BASE_W04, reconciled ownership/base records and functioning accepted W03 Billing obligations with immutable quote/amount/subject references.
Frozen Billing/Wallet cash commands, receipts, settlement/status/query/event/recovery contracts and compatible A/C/D assignment/completion, customer/guest and reconciliation interfaces.

Approved collection timing, partial/overpayment, discrepancy, custody holder/hold purpose, money/accounting/posting, handover/treasury acceptance, cancellation/refund and replay/time/privacy policies.
Actual current assignment/completion and collector grants, distinct independent treasury authority, service delegation and customer/guest receipt object-access grants.
E-published manifests/dependencies, client/parser exports, Gateway routes/errors, broker producer/consumer permissions and executable provider/consumer gates.
E-allocated and actually provisioned isolated Billing/Wallet PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, browser/runtime resources, pinned toolchain and owned process/cleanup evidence.
Downstream serialized actual three-app cash-flow and unchanged-ref candidate/resulting-target acceptance; the first provider child does not depend on an unbuilt consumer.

notes: Observed main is an audit source, not BASE_W04. All cases remain NOT_RUN_SPECIFICATION_ONLY and runtimeExecuted=false; accepted business contracts and executable cash providers are absent at this source.

Billing and Wallet persistence currently consists of ServiceMarker foundation tables. The historical Billing assertBalancedJournal helper is unconnected pure code, not an accounting-policy decision or database posting control.

Creating an obligation, completing work, accepting customer cash and settling business custody are separate authoritative facts. None is inferred from navigation, local state, a proof image or another fact's success.

Policy-derived positive/negative vectors must come from accepted revisions. No account number/category, currency/exponent/bound, fee/tax, holder, merchant, tolerance, hold purpose, replay period, deadline, endpoint or receipt format is selected here.

Approved full-only versus partial-collection rules must freeze the unique collection identity grain and permitted installment references. No private identity scheme is introduced to permit partial collection or reject an approved partial policy.

Runtime-role SQL tests must prove the permitted posting boundary and append-only facts, including E-owned provisioning/grant replay. Superuser or migration-role success is not runtime immutability evidence.

Wallet has no independent financial ledger and never reads Billing tables. Custody projections and purpose-specific holds are reconciled through accepted authoritative Billing receipt/posting/status references.

Provider children first prove real owned DB/HTTP/Identity/constraints and accepted dependencies. Wallet consumes merged Billing; A/C/D consumers and full-flow acceptance follow in serialized order without a mutual fixture dependency.

No distributed transaction or exactly-once delivery is asserted. Owner-local atomic commits, stable logical identities and Inbox/Outbox recovery must produce one accepted business effect under repeat delivery.

Private downloadable receipt access uses the accepted account or guest capability and object authorization. A downloadable document cannot disclose ledger secrets or serve as authority for changing financial state.

Fixtures remain explicitly isolated test fixtures, never production fallbacks or proof of real assignment/work/obligations/treasury/provider operations. Missing/failed/skipped/cancelled required evidence keeps the relevant parent gate open.

Future execution records exact commands, source/tree, contract/policy versions, real versus mocked resources, owned process handles, results and cleanup. W04 implementation never automatically starts W05 or authorizes merge/deployment/live money.

Separate runtime/migration identities, schema/constraint inventory and before/after historical row/reference comparisons

cases.title: Reversal-first, settlement-first, revision gaps and stale events recover without false facts
given: Frozen events distinguish owner/resource revisions from aggregate event versions and define conflict/gap/stale/snapshot recovery.
Actual Billing/Wallet providers expose accepted authorized immutable source/status lookup for reconciliation.
when: Deliver a reversal before its collection, settlement before handover/source posting, revision gaps and older events after newer projections.
Reuse an event identity with conflicting content, unsupported schema or forged producer and exercise approved retry/quarantine/dead-letter recovery.
then: Missing ordered prerequisites remain explicit/reconciliation-pending and recover through authorized owner facts without inventing collection or settlement.
Stale evidence never overwrites newer accepted facts; conflicting identity content never becomes a second financial/custody effect.
Recovery follows the published contract, with no global event-order assumption, peer SQL read or private revision coercion.
requiredEvidence: Real RabbitMQ reordered/gapped/stale/conflicting event timelines and accepted recovery/ACL results
Owner lookup provenance, PostgreSQL inbox/checkpoint/projection comparisons and safe quarantine evidence

cases.title: Reconciliation proves exact Billing-backed custody and detects stale or missing projection evidence
given: Accepted public reconciliation/status contracts expose only authorized immutable source references and explicit revision/as-of/gap evidence.
Real collections, linked corrections, pending handovers and settlements exist with known owner-local source histories.
when: Reconcile authorized Billing receipts/postings to Wallet custody/holds/projection through real service interfaces after delayed/lost deliveries.
Introduce a stale or incomplete projection through controlled delivery interruption and recover using accepted owner snapshots/checkpoints.
then: Exact per-currency source-linked custody and settlements converge without double counting original/reversal/settlement effects.
Until source gaps are resolved, affected queries remain explicitly stale/pending/disputed and cannot authorize settlement from incomplete totals or report missing custody as zero/unpaid/settled.
Reconciliation never becomes a second ledger, automatic adjustment authority or cross-owner database repair.
requiredEvidence: Actual authorized source/status/reconciliation HTTP traces and exact per-currency reference comparisons
Controlled delivery interruption, checkpoint/snapshot recovery and no-extra-effect PostgreSQL results

cases.title: Cancellation after collection preserves cash and exposes approved refund or compensation state
given: Approved policy and frozen contracts define cancellation before/after collection, correction/reversal authority and pending refund/compensation evidence.
Real collected obligations exist with pending and settled custody variants.
when: Cancel a collected Booking/obligation through its actual owner command and race cancellation versus collection under accepted revision/timing rules.
Retry approved linked correction/compensation and query independent financial/custody status without executing live refunds.
then: Cancellation cannot delete accepted cash/receipt/journal history or silently change collected money back to unpaid.
Required refund/compensation remains explicit and recoverable under approved authority; refunded is never inferred before authoritative completion evidence.
Linked corrections preserve original facts, prevent duplicate effects and do not resurrect Booking/capacity/work or fabricate returned cash.
requiredEvidence: Real owner cancellation/collection race, revision and replay HTTP outcomes
Immutable original receipt/posting/custody rows, approved pending/refund-state evidence and linked correction counts

cases.title: Failed handover and compensation preserve durable recovery identities and original custody
given: Approved handover/hold/settlement policy freezes compensatable transitions, distinct child operation identities and unknown-outcome recovery.
Actual Billing and Wallet have committed owned states without a distributed transaction.
when: Fail after pending handover/hold commit or after Billing settlement before Wallet receives its fact, lose compensation responses and restart actual owners.
Replay stable original/compensation identities, deliver delayed success and race accepted release/consume/correction transitions.
then: Only accepted serialized transitions and one linked compensation effect survive; original collection and custody evidence remain intact.
Unknown outcomes remain queryable/pending and recover through authoritative status rather than new-key retries or optimistic releases.
Delayed facts cannot silently transfer custody, release consumed holds, undo accepted settlement or write peer state.
requiredEvidence: Real process/HTTP/broker failure and recovery timelines with original/child operation identity linkage
Billing/Wallet immutable source, hold/custody/compensation effect counts and accepted transition provenance

cases.title: Missing policy or provider authority blocks dependent writes without prototype defaults
given: D/E publish approved policy revisions and required actual authority/provider dependencies for collection, custody and treasury settlement.
Historical helpers and frozen HTML demonstrators contain illustrative values that are not production financial policy.
when: Start or execute dependent operations with missing/unknown/revoked/inconsistent timing, money, accounting, holder, hold-purpose or discrepancy policies.
Remove required current authority/provider availability and inspect accepted readiness/error/recovery behavior and sanitized observability.
then: Dependent financial writes refuse or remain explicitly pending under accepted unavailable/unknown rules; no fabricated BUSINESS_READY or success is returned.
No helper regex/amount limit, demo currency/price, arbitrary tolerance/deadline, account/holder or self-approval becomes a default.
Previously committed historical evidence is preserved and safely readable only under accepted access semantics; logs expose references rather than private credentials/proof/tokens.
requiredEvidence: Actual configuration/authority/provider outage HTTP/readiness matrix and PostgreSQL no-effect results
Accepted policy provenance, source fallback inspection and sanitized log/trace/event evidence

cases.title: Sequential real providers conform to published cash and custody contracts
given: E accepts actual Identity/C assignment/work and W03 obligation prerequisites before Billing cash provider; Wallet is evaluated against that now-merged real Billing provider.
Published public parsers/clients/events and exact accepted package/policy versions identify real provider candidates and executable bounded gates.
when: Run real Billing owned PostgreSQL/HTTP/Identity/constraint/receipt gates, then Wallet owned PostgreSQL/HTTP/Identity/broker conformance against actual merged Billing.
Exercise supported success, safe errors, replay, revisions and recovery through published transport rather than private DTOs or implementation imports.
then: Each provider proves its own real bounded behavior and accepted dependencies before downstream app consumers are evaluated.
There is no circular requirement that first providers already possess their unbuilt full three-app journey, and no fixture is relabeled real producer evidence.
Exact versions, schema/migration inventory and independent review requirements remain visible; parent full-flow acceptance stays pending until integration cases pass.
requiredEvidence: Actual merged prerequisite/Billing/Wallet SHA/tree, accepted versions and sequential executable provider gate results
Real PostgreSQL/HTTP/Identity/RabbitMQ environments, public dependency boundary inventory and bounded provider review evidence

cases.title: The actual three-app completed cash order produces one downloadable receipt and reconciled settlement
given: E constructs the latest-target-plus-head immutable combined candidate after actual Dispatch/Work, Billing/Wallet and A/C/D finance consumers are accepted in sequence.
The isolated candidate runs real customer-web, operator-web, admin-web, Gateway/Identity, actual quote/Booking/obligation/work providers and provisioned PostgreSQL/RabbitMQ with approved policies.
when: Complete the real seven-step Arabic RTL account and accepted guest cash booking variants with optional plate, then actual authorized assignment/service completion.
Collect once in operator-web, read paid status and download the real customer receipt, observe pending custody, perform approved handover/deposit and independent admin settlement.
Read final owner facts and all affected application displays, with required browser/accessibility and canonical reference/candidate/diff evidence.
then: One integrated full cash order produces one authoritative receipt, exact reconcilable Billing journals and source-linked Wallet custody/settlement records across all three apps.
Customer paid status correctly coexists with unsettled technician custody before independent settlement; all displays follow server facts and explicit stale/unknown evidence.

Approved visuals, Arabic copy, seven separate steps, focus/reduced-motion, guest access, optional plates and existing cash/ShamCash/Syriatel methods remain intact without a fourth method or demo fallback.
requiredEvidence: Actual combined candidate SHA/tree, provider/consumer SHAs, approved versions and unchanged head/target refs
Real three-app browser/HTTP/download journey and exact Billing/Wallet PostgreSQL journals/receipt/custody/outbox/reconciliation evidence
Affected canonical parity/reference/candidate/diff, accessibility and required runtime/gate results with real versus mocked environments labeled

cases.title: Real three-app offline races and injected delivery failures recover without duplicate or false success
given: The accepted combined source runs actual A/C/D applications and Billing/Wallet with real current Identity/assignment/treasury/guest providers and allocated databases/broker.
Controlled browser offline queues, HTTP response loss, owner crash and broker/projection fault injection preserve original accepted operation identities.
when: Repeat collection offline/online with same and different keys, race two collectors/conflicting amounts and retry handover/deposit after response loss.
Exercise unrelated/stale/foreign collector, guest receipt and admin settlement denials through real apps; interrupt receipt delivery, journal/outbox/projection delivery and recover actual owners.
Expose policy-derived discrepancy and cancellation-after-collection variants and verify recovery/status after browser reload and server restart.
then: Actual owner effect counts show no double collection, receipt, custody transfer or settlement despite device/network/broker retries.
Apps never equate timeout, proof image, local completion, receipt-download attempt or pending handover with received money or settled treasury.
Unauthorized operations have no effect; unresolved discrepancies and refund/compensation remain owner-assigned and visible, and real recovery preserves exact immutable facts.
requiredEvidence: Actual browser offline/race/denial/reload evidence with real HTTP/Identity/provider and crash/broker timelines
Combined-source Billing/Wallet PostgreSQL effect counts and exact discrepancy/cancellation/compensation/reconciliation outcomes
Unchanged-ref candidate provenance and affected A/C/D/E mandatory integrated gate results

cases.title: Fixture boundaries and final evidence keep W04 pending until actual combined acceptance
given: Any shape/domain fixture is explicitly isolated and labeled, while evidence identifies executable command, result, source/tree, contracts/policies and actual environment for every required case.
E's serialized process requires current candidate/resulting-target checks and applicable independent review without self-approval or automatic merge.
when: Audit fixture wiring, production fallbacks, all required case/gate results, migration/resource/process evidence and unchanged head/target refs.
Verify accepted provider and consumer evidence against actual combined source and inspect the next-wave W05 verification/proof/review/refund/late-payment request handoff.
then: Fixtures, declarations, old head checks, foundation-only CI and skipped/cancelled/not-run cases never close real three-app cash or treasury acceptance.
Provider children may be accepted on real bounded evidence while W04-B stays INTEGRATION_PENDING until every required combined-source case and resulting-target gate succeeds.

Changed refs require applicable recomputation/reruns; missing evidence has an explicit owner/next action, allocated resources are cleaned up, and no DONE/W05 execution/live money/deployment is implied.
requiredEvidence: Evidence-to-case matrix distinguishing real/mocked/not-run environments and source/configuration fixture audit
Exact candidate/resulting-target refs, mandatory gate results and independent review provenance
Owned process/resource cleanup evidence, explicit blocked cases/dependency owners and reviewable W05 handoff links
